mission.stated: A top-down arena shooter built with Godot 4.3 and C# (.NET 8). Fight waves of enemies across 4 hero classes; environmental destruction escalates threat via the Collateral Karma system.
mission.actual: Wave survival loop is complete (spawning, mutators, AoE fixed per PRs #18/#19), 4 hero classes each with Attack/Dodge/Ability, Collateral Karma threat escalation, difficulty selector persisted to user://settings.cfg, 345 headless xUnit tests pass.
mission.gap: Three gaps: (1) Late-game difficulty decays (Weibull peaks ~wave 5 then tapers) contradicting 'escalating threat'. (2) Perk synergies are tags only; 9 perk effects declared but never consumed. (3) No meta-progression between runs; every run starts from baseline.

codeQuality.finding: Pure-logic extraction convention followed: GameManagerState, InputBufferState, ProgressionFormulas, WaveFormulas, EntityRegistry, HitFlashPalette, DestructionTracker, PowerupBannerSlots, PerkSystem, HeroStats are Godot-free classes delegated to by Node wrappers. 345 headless xUnit tests pass.

Nine perk effects declared but never consumed (HealthRegen, ExplosiveRounds, LifeSteal, CritChance, SlowOnHit, BurnOnHit, FrostAura, ThornArmor, DoubleJump). Dead code misleads players about what perks do.

architecture.finding: Clear separation of concerns: EventBus decouples systems; WaveManager/EnemyMutatorSystem apply mutators at spawn; SpatialHashGrid O(1) spatial queries; FlowFieldPathfinder on background thread.
DifficultySettings defines EnemyHealthMultiplier, EnemyDamageMultiplier, XpMultiplier but no runtime consumer — defined + unit-tested but unused.
EnemyMutatorSystem.OnThreatChanged is an empty stub — mutators applied once at spawn, never re-applied as threat rises. Splitting mutator commented out.

testing.finding: Both gates run locally: xUnit (345 tests, unfiltered) + Godot headless gate (13/13 PASS). Residual deprecated GetUninitializedObject fixtures exist in 4 suites but pass headlessly.

security.finding: No secrets, auth, or network code in the codebase — single-player offline game. No external API keys or credentials.

performance.finding: ObjectPoolManager pre-allocates 5000 projectiles + 10000 decals at startup (zero runtime instantiation). SpatialHashGrid O(1) spatial queries. Flow-field pathfinding at ~4 Hz on background thread. MAX_SPAWNS_PER_FRAME=20 throttle.

optimality.algorithm: Weibull intensity curve for wave spawning is appropriate for horde-shooter density ramps (rises from 0, peaks ~wave 5). SpatialHashGrid O(1) queries optimal for collision-heavy arena combat. However Weibull decays after wave 5 — late waves get easier, contradicting 'escalating threat'.
optimality.complexity: Spawn capped at MAX_ENEMIES=2000 with MAX_SPAWNS_PER_FRAME=20 throttle — O(cap) per frame, bounded. Flow field on background thread at ~4 Hz avoids main-thread stalls.
optimality.resources: Object pool eliminates runtime GC pressure from projectile/decal instantiation.
alternatives: Replace decaying Weibull late-game with additive per-wave HP/damage multiplier (RoR2/Brotato pattern).
Replace flat per-perk stats with prerequisite-driven synergies (Hades Duo Boons pattern).
optimality.scalability: 2000 enemy cap is a hard backstop; at 10x spawn demand the spawn loop runs zero times once full (WaveFormulas.cs:48-50). Acceptable as safety valve but late-wave intensity plateaus.

recommendations.title: R1 — Replace decaying late-game Weibull with sustained/escalating intensity
recommendations.why: Late waves get easier, contradicting the 'escalating threat' mission. Vampire Survivors keeps pressure via time-based HP scalars that make difficulty catch up (Tier 3: Arcade Artificer). RoR2 scales difficulty coefficient with stages/time (Tier 2). Brotato's Endless Factor adds multiplicative HP/damage escalation past wave 20 (Tier 2: Brotato Wiki).
recommendations.what: Add a per-wave HP/damage multiplier that scales with wave number (e.g., +1x base HP per boss cycle, additive not compounding). Keep the 2000 enemy cap as hard backstop. Add an optional 'Curse'-style toggle trading enemy HP/speed/density for gold/XP. Expose a visible threat-level meter driven by waves cleared (RoR2 HUD bar pattern).
recommendations.endpoint: Modify scripts/core/WaveFormulas.cs (CalculateWaveEnemyCount) and scripts/core/WaveManager.cs (BeginNextWave spawner); add threat-meter UI to scripts/ui/HUD.cs.
recommendations.interactiveControl: Difficulty toggle 'Curse mode' in MainMenu difficulty selector; threat-level progress bar on HUD.
recommendations.source: scripts/core/WaveFormulas.cs:26-51; Arcade Artificer Substack (Tier 3); RoR2 Difficulty (Tier 2); Brotato Wiki Endless Mode (Tier 2)

recommendations.title: R2 — Implement real perk synergy combos (prerequisite-driven emergent effects)
recommendations.why: Perks carry SynergyTag but no synergy mechanics; nine effects are declared but unconsumed. Hades' 28 Duo Boons show prerequisite-driven perk pairs create emergent power and thrilling discoveries (Tier 2: TheGamer). Vampire Survivors' weapon evolutions (max level + passive prereq) are a discrete synergy lever (Tier 2: teemo.dev).
recommendations.what: Add 4-6 two-perk synergy triggers with emergent results (e.g., FrostAura + SlowOnHit → brief freeze; BurnOnHit + ExplosiveRounds → exploding burning-corpse chain). Gate each emergent perk behind two base perks already taken. Show synergy hints on perk cards when one perk away from unlocking. Consume the nine dead effects (HealthRegen regen tick, ExplosiveRounds projectile flag, LifeSteal heal-on-kill, CritChance roll, SlowOnHit/BurnOnHit/FrostAura/ThornArmor/DoubleJump consumers).
recommendations.endpoint: Extend scripts/core/PerkSystem.cs ApplyPerk with a synergy table; add synergy hints to scripts/ui/UpgradeMenu.cs perk cards; wire consumers in hero attack/dodge/take-damage paths (HeroBase.cs, Atlas.cs, Zephyr.cs, Synapse.cs, Volt.cs).
recommendations.interactiveControl: Perk-card synergy badges/hints in UpgradeMenu; 'evolution' perk flagged in offer pool when prerequisites met.
recommendations.source: scripts/core/PerkSystem.cs:13-87; scripts/core/HeroStats.cs:10-29; Hades Duo Boons (Tier 2); Vampire Survivors weapon evolutions (Tier 2)

recommendations.title: R3 — Add meta-progression between runs (gold kept on death, permanent stat shop)
recommendations.why: No meta-progression means every run starts from zero — 'zero progress' runs. Vampire Survivors' meta-progression (gold kept on death, escalating stat shop at 1.1^TotalBought pricing, full respec) eliminates this and drives immediate retries (~2.5x damage / 2x health cumulative; Tier 3: Arcade Artificer). Hades Mirror of Night shows Darkness + Chthonic Keys gating with refundable unlocks, max achievable in ~50 runs (Tier 2: TheGamer).
recommendations.what: Award run currency (scrap) based on kills/destruction/wave reached, kept after death. Spend in a main-menu permanent node tree for starting-stat bonuses (+max health, +move speed, +starting damage) and hero unlocks. Add slow tiny-stat 'egg' track for long-term accumulation. Include full-respec button.
recommendations.endpoint: New scripts/core/MetaProgressionState.cs (Godot-free, headless-testable) + scripts/ui/MainMenu.cs meta-progression screen; save to user://meta.cfg via ConfigFile (mirroring MenuDifficultyState pattern).
recommendations.interactiveControl: Meta-progression node tree in MainMenu; scrap currency display on HUD/run-end screen; respec button.
recommendations.source: Arcade Artificer Substack (Tier 3); Vampire Survivors PowerUp shop (Tier 2); Hades Mirror of Night (Tier 2); scripts/core/MenuDifficultyState.cs (existing pattern)

recommendations.title: R4 — Re-apply mutators as threat rises (EnemyMutatorSystem.OnThreatChanged)
recommendations.why: Mutators applied once at spawn only; rising threat never re-mutates live enemies. OnThreatChanged is an empty stub. Splitting mutator commented out. Wastes the threat system's escalation potential.
recommendations.what: Implement OnThreatChanged to re-apply stacking mutators to live enemies as threat increases (capped per-mutator to avoid runaway). Un-comment and implement the splitting mutator as a high-threat elite wave mechanic (Brotato: +1 elite per 10 waves).
recommendations.endpoint: Implement scripts/systems/EnemyMutatorSystem.cs OnThreatChanged(int) + ApplySingleMutator extension for live enemies; add splitting mutator.
recommendations.interactiveControl: Threat-level-driven mutator intensity visible on HUD threat meter.
